users_last_analysis_check.name: users_last_analysis_check
users_last_analysis_check.value:
("users"."last_analysis_at" is null and "users"."last_analysis_asset_id" is null
        and "users"."last_analysis_duration_sec" is null)
        or ("users"."last_analysis_at" is not null and "users"."last_analysis_asset_id" is not null
          and "users"."last_analysis_duration_sec" is not null and "users"."last_analysis_asset_id" > 0
          and "users"."last_analysis_duration_sec" > 0)

token_ledger_reference_check.name: token_ledger_reference_check
token_ledger_reference_check.value:
case
            when "token_ledger"."kind" in ('reserve', 'release', 'settle')
              then "token_ledger"."intent_id" is not null and "token_ledger"."deposit_event_id" is null
                and "token_ledger"."broker_account_id" is null and "token_ledger"."ref_id" is null
                and "token_ledger"."star_payment_id" is null and "token_ledger"."referral_id" is null
            when "token_ledger"."kind" = 'purchase'
              then "token_ledger"."intent_id" is null and "token_ledger"."broker_account_id" is null and "token_ledger"."ref_id" is null
                and "token_ledger"."referral_id" is null
                and ("token_ledger"."deposit_event_id" is not null) <> ("token_ledger"."star_payment_id" is not null)
            when "token_ledger"."kind" = 'bonus'
              then "token_ledger"."intent_id" is null and "token_ledger"."ref_id" is null and "token_ledger"."star_payment_id" is null
                and num_nonnulls("token_ledger"."deposit_event_id", "token_ledger"."broker_account_id", "token_ledger"."referral_id") <= 1
            when "token_ledger"."kind" = 'refund'
              then "token_ledger"."star_payment_id" is not null and "token_ledger"."intent_id" is null
                and "token_ledger"."deposit_event_id" is null and "token_ledger"."broker_account_id" is null
                and "token_ledger"."ref_id" is null and "token_ledger"."referral_id" is null
            else "token_ledger"."intent_id" is null and "token_ledger"."deposit_event_id" is null and "token_ledger"."broker_account_id" is null
              and "token_ledger"."star_payment_id" is null and "token_ledger"."referral_id" is null
          end

token_ledger_bonus_rule_check.name: token_ledger_bonus_rule_check
token_ledger_bonus_rule_check.value:
case
            when "token_ledger"."kind" = 'bonus'
              then "token_ledger"."bonus_rule_id" is not null and "token_ledger"."bonus_rule_kind" is not null
                and case
                  when "token_ledger"."broker_account_id" is not null
                    then "token_ledger"."bonus_rule_kind" = 'link_bonus'
                  when "token_ledger"."deposit_event_id" is not null
                    then "token_ledger"."bonus_rule_kind" = 'deposit_bonus'
                  when "token_ledger"."referral_id" is not null
                    then "token_ledger"."bonus_rule_kind" = 'referral_reward'
                  else false
                end
            else "token_ledger"."bonus_rule_id" is null and "token_ledger"."bonus_rule_kind" is null
          end

token_ledger_delta_shape_check.name: token_ledger_delta_shape_check
token_ledger_delta_shape_check.value:
case "token_ledger"."kind"
            when 'reserve' then "token_ledger"."reserved_delta" > 0 and "token_ledger"."balance_delta" = 0
            when 'release' then "token_ledger"."reserved_delta" < 0 and "token_ledger"."balance_delta" = 0
            when 'settle' then "token_ledger"."reserved_delta" < 0
            when 'purchase' then "token_ledger"."balance_delta" > 0 and "token_ledger"."reserved_delta" = 0
            when 'bonus' then "token_ledger"."balance_delta" > 0 and "token_ledger"."reserved_delta" = 0
            when 'refund' then "token_ledger"."balance_delta" < 0 and "token_ledger"."reserved_delta" = 0
            else true
          end

token_ledger_adjustment_note_check.name: token_ledger_adjustment_note_check
token_ledger_adjustment_note_check.value: "token_ledger"."kind" <> 'adjustment' or ("token_ledger"."note" is not null and char_length("token_ledger"."note") between 1 and 512)

trading_sessions_tracked_idx.name: trading_sessions_tracked_idx
trading_sessions_tracked_idx.where: "trading_sessions"."status_message_id" is not null and "trading_sessions"."summary_sent_at" is null

trading_sessions_summary_fallback_idx.name: trading_sessions_summary_fallback_idx
trading_sessions_summary_fallback_idx.where: "trading_sessions"."final_notice_sent_at" is not null and "trading_sessions"."summary_sent_at" is null

trading_sessions_waiting_pair_check.name: trading_sessions_waiting_pair_check
trading_sessions_waiting_pair_check.value: "trading_sessions"."waiting_message_id" is null or "trading_sessions"."waiting_after_message" is not null

trade_intents_decision_session_check.name: trade_intents_decision_session_check
trade_intents_decision_session_check.value: "trade_intents"."signal_decision_id" is null or "trade_intents"."trading_session_id" is not null

trade_intents_submit_window_check.name: trade_intents_submit_window_check
trade_intents_submit_window_check.value: "trade_intents"."submit_not_before_at" is null or "trade_intents"."submit_deadline_at" is null or "trade_intents"."submit_not_before_at" < "trade_intents"."submit_deadline_at"

signal_decisions_account_pair_check.name: signal_decisions_account_pair_check
signal_decisions_account_pair_check.value: "signal_decisions"."context" not in ('session', 'session_start') or "signal_decisions"."broker_account_id" is not null

decision_ticks_ticks_check.name: decision_ticks_ticks_check
decision_ticks_ticks_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("decision_ticks"."ticks") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("decision_ticks"."ticks") = "decision_ticks"."count" else false end

broker_trades_close_price_check.name: broker_trades_close_price_check
broker_trades_close_price_check.value: "broker_trades"."close_price" is null or ("broker_trades"."close_price" > '-Infinity'::double precision and "broker_trades"."close_price" < 'Infinity'::double precision)

deposit_events_mode_switch_pending_idx.name: deposit_events_mode_switch_pending_idx
deposit_events_mode_switch_pending_idx.where: "deposit_events"."user_id" is not null and "deposit_events"."mode_switch" is null

deposit_events_owner_pair_check.name: deposit_events_owner_pair_check
deposit_events_owner_pair_check.value: "deposit_events"."user_id" is null or "deposit_events"."broker_account_id" is not null

postback_deliveries_outcome_shape_check.name: postback_deliveries_outcome_shape_check
postback_deliveries_outcome_shape_check.value:
case
        when "postback_deliveries"."outcome" = 'rejected'
          then "postback_deliveries"."deposit_event_id" is null and "postback_deliveries"."reject_reason" is not null
        else "postback_deliveries"."deposit_event_id" is not null and "postback_deliveries"."reject_reason" is null
          and "postback_deliveries"."postback_id" is not null and "postback_deliveries"."event" is not null
      end

bonus_rules_validity_check.name: bonus_rules_validity_check
bonus_rules_validity_check.value: "bonus_rules"."valid_from" is null or "bonus_rules"."valid_to" is null or "bonus_rules"."valid_to" > "bonus_rules"."valid_from"

staff_login_challenges_code_status_check.name: staff_login_challenges_code_status_check
staff_login_challenges_code_status_check.value:
case
            when "staff_login_challenges"."status" = 'pending' then "staff_login_challenges"."code_hash" is null
            when "staff_login_challenges"."status" in ('confirmed', 'completed', 'exhausted') then "staff_login_challenges"."code_hash" is not null
            else true
          end

staff_login_challenges_code_sent_check.name: staff_login_challenges_code_sent_check
staff_login_challenges_code_sent_check.value: "staff_login_challenges"."code_sent_at" is null or ("staff_login_challenges"."code_hash" is not null and "staff_login_challenges"."code_sent_at" >= "staff_login_challenges"."created_at")

staff_sessions_revoked_by_pair_check.name: staff_sessions_revoked_by_pair_check
staff_sessions_revoked_by_pair_check.value: "staff_sessions"."revoked_by_staff_id" is null or "staff_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null
